clips.title: The story
paras: Near the mountain passes, Pilot Hammerfoot watches over the Siege Brigade’s engines and worries for a missing fellow pilot. He seeks travelers to search the hills, where the high ridges put dwarves in danger.

At North Gate Outpost, Pilot Hammerfoot watches the passes between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan and guards the Siege Brigade’s engines. Ironforge’s siege engines are prized by the brigade, but rough mountain ground makes them dangerous to drive. When a pilot goes missing, finding him matters, especially with savage beasts roaming the nearby hills.
